ReleaseNotes.ReleaseNote: First release. Whetstone International (H28 / CEQ4), the grass strip on the Canada-US border at Del Bonita, Alberta / Montana. Runway 07/25 (4,440 ft between the threshold cones) with its border fences, cone markers, PAPI on 07 and windsock; US parking and Canadian pocket with tie-downs; the CBSA and CBP ports of entry with night lighting; power lines with marker balls; border monuments 308A/308B, the border gates, the RCMP cairn, the Whetstone, CBP and CBSA signs and the Welcome to Alberta sign. Fictional RNAV (GPS) RWY 25 and RNAV (GPS)-A approaches, not for real-world navigation. Building footprints and the field outline.
Stub: marker moved to the runway, runway 07/25 on the Canada-US border.
